notes.sound: A soft square-and-saw keys sound with a long, ringing tail when you let go slowly. Lift a key quickly and the tail is cut short and darker. A keyboard without release velocity sends the same lift every time: then it's a medium tail.
notes.shows: Release velocity (firmware 0.10.0) into the amp and filter release with negative depths: a quick lift, a short tail. Older firmware plays it with the long tail.
